# Gyanama

> Gyanama is an AI operating system for schools. Unlike traditional school management software that only stores data and waits for staff to act, Gyanama understands what is happening across a school, identifies what needs attention, and takes action automatically — such as calling a parent when a student's attendance drops.

## What Gyanama is
Gyanama is an AI operating system for K-12 schools in India. Traditional school software (school ERPs, management systems) records attendance, fees and marks and then waits for a human to notice a problem and act. Gyanama adds an intelligent layer that reads school activity, surfaces what needs attention, and initiates action automatically.

## Who it is for
School owners, principals, directors and senior management of private K-12 schools in India, plus their teachers, parents and students.

## What Gyanama does (outcomes, not just features)
- Detects attendance drops and automatically calls the parent in the school's voice and the parent's language, then logs the outcome.
- Automates fee reminder calls and tracks who has paid, so staff stop chasing payments manually.
- Generates syllabus- and book-aligned assignments and quizzes for teachers in minutes.
- Produces a live health/intelligence score for every student, every class, and the whole school, surfacing who needs attention early.
- Surfaces the students and areas that require management attention.
- Connects management, teachers, students and parents through one intelligent school operating layer.

## How Gyanama is different from a school ERP
- Traditional software stores attendance; Gyanama notices attendance problems and calls the parent.
- Traditional software records fees; Gyanama follows up on pending fees automatically.
- Traditional software holds marks; Gyanama surfaces students who need attention, early.
- Traditional software shows a dashboard; Gyanama tells you what deserves attention today.
- Traditional software waits for a command; Gyanama acts on what is happening.

## Platforms
Web, Android and iOS, with role-based apps for management, teachers, parents and students.

## Company
Gyanama is built by Yash Bhardwaj (Co-founder, CEO) and Rachit Mittal (Co-founder, CTO). Data handling is designed around India's DPDP Act, 2023.
